questions.question: What did Ezekiel see by the Chebar canal in his opening vision?
options: A long scroll flying through the air, all covered over in writing
A great and shining city descending from heaven in bright light
A wide valley filled with very dry and scattered dead bones
Four living creatures and wheels, with the glory of the LORD
questions.answer: Four living creatures and wheels, with the glory of the LORD

questions.question: How many faces did each living creature have?
options: Seven (one for each of the spirits)
